findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (53.45 yds from volume vs 48.38 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.71 per player (projected 31.13, actual 31.84).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.08 (projected 7.17, actual 7.09).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 66.31, without it 65.4. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 41/116 (35.34%). Our MAE 65.29 vs the line's 58.89. The book is the better projection.
